gloss: repertory cinema; art-house theater showing classic films

definitions.gloss: repertory cinema; art-house theater that screens classic and notable films
definitions.explanation: A type of movie theater that specializes in showing older classic films, foreign films, and critically acclaimed works rather than new releases. Typically charges lower admission than first-run cinemas.

examples.japanese: ⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名画座|めいがざ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{観|み}た→観る：22793_miru⟧。
examples.english: I watched an old movie at the local repertory cinema.

examples.japanese: {名画座|めいがざ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二本立|にほんだ}て⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{千円|せんえん}→千円：08980_senen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧。
examples.english: The repertory cinema is cheap — a double feature for 1,000 yen.

examples.english: There used to be repertory cinemas all over town, but the number has been declining.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{名画|めいが}→名画：17385_meiga⟧ (masterpiece film) + ⟦{座|ざ}→座：28170_za⟧ (theater, venue). A uniquely Japanese cultural institution. These theaters show double or triple features of older films at lower prices than first-run cinemas.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {名画座|めいがざ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{観|み}る→観る：22793_miru⟧: to watch at a repertory cinema
- {名画座|めいがざ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{二本立|にほんだ}て: a double feature at a repertory cinema
- {名画座|めいがざ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{閉館|へいかん}→閉館：18858_heikan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: a repertory cinema closes down

CULTURAL NOTE:
{名画座|めいがざ} were once widespread in Japanese cities, especially during the Showa era. Famous surviving examples include {早稲田松竹|わせだしょうちく} in Tokyo. They are beloved by film enthusiasts for their curated programs and affordable prices, but many have closed due to the rise of home video and streaming.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{映画館|えいがかん}→映画館：01024_eigakan⟧: movie theater — the general term for any cinema, including first-run
- ミニシアター: mini-theater — a small independent theater that shows art films and indie works, but focuses on newer releases rather than classics
